game.name: Otomedius Gorgeous (Japan)
game.desc: Otomedius Gorgeous is a side scrolling shoot'em up that is a port of the Arcade game Otomedius for the Xbox 360. It was only released in Japan, and features various Konami properties represented as scantily clad anime girls. It is a spin off of the Gradius series, and a spiritual sequel to the Parodius series.
